behavioral_effects: None stated. An empty list is a claim that nothing observably changes.
compatibility_impact: Additive. A seventh kernel-internal schema binding; existing documents and bindings unchanged. The read surface and catalog gain the evaluations directory because it now exists, per the declared catalog spec.
reason: The blueprint requires growth triggers to become evaluation records before build tasks; the phase-6 trigger is being deliberately pre-empted by owner decision, and governance/history/evaluations/ has no schema binding today so a record there would fail the blocking document check
rollback: Revert the commit. The schema binding and the record are inert data; removing them returns governance/history/evaluations/ to declared-but-absent, and sync regenerates catalog and read-surface accordingly.
security_impact: None. Adds a kernel-internal validation schema and one curated JSON record; no runtime code paths, no secrets, no network or database access.
summary: Evaluation records: kernel-internal schema and the phase-6 trigger pre-emption record
